answer: Sybil resistance here works by bonding stake to a verified identity at the bridge between agents and the registry: each new agent must lock a minimum amount of tokens plus a small proof-of-personhood attestation before joining. Attacker cost scales linearly, since N fake agents require N bonds that are slashed on collusion, making mass registration economically irrational.
